sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: All for the Show - Soldier is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Too many soft types running around in flashy gear lately. That's not how it should be. Let's bring some real soldier spirit back to the Arena! Being flashy is fine, but right now the crowd wants real fighters, men, soldiers! So pick something appropriate from your gear."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 50 enemies while wearing any beret in CheckPoint mode

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +7,500 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.01
- 60,000 Roubles
- 50 GP coins
- Unlocks MPS Auto Assault-12 Gen 2 12ga automatic shotgun in the Armory
